body:
Records an unpromoted fixed-prompt decoder recovery candidate and its controlled qualification. After preemption, the candidate replays the original prompt suffix plus accepted output rows. Actual streaming-input sessions preserve existing behavior because their earlier CED phases require a separate recovery design. Source draft: https://github.com/christopherowen/vllm/pull/6.

Current source head `c229ab4d2c4d18b3dcd157ff8a3ec7255108164e`, tree `11d1cf3e6ac525173683dbfcd3b08de1c945934d`; all 575 ordered patches reproduce them on DGX4. The Python-only screen mounts four exact published source files over candidate-38 image `sha256:213ba4df68d06665add7a26260c2321d55854a75b8a51ae71c72d0b97eac814b`. All-rank source hashes and read-only mount checks supplement ordinary image/deployment checks.

Current group/identity tests: 183 passed. Initial causal fixture: candidate 168 passed, locked control six recovery-boundary failures and 162 passes. Prior broader CPU suite: 395 passed with four HiSparse cases still unqualified; both arms fail device inference without a GPU. Also recorded: 45 isolated policy cases, 27 mathematical dependency cases, six streaming-phase cases, 24 harness tests including cancellation confirmation, exact request targeting, ownership loss and source identity checks. These do not establish native or checkpoint equivalence. Fresh series and doctor receipts, failed setup attempts, and exact cleanup receipts are retained. No complete image build is claimed.

The serving probe now includes a cancelled producer and same-prefix follower. It requires exact request identity, a server-confirmed abort, an idle queue, positive cached-token usage and matching follower tokens/logprobs. Native control tests are separated from candidate-only API tests; the runbook records the current tests plus compiled-image mount layout.

Still draft: native old-fails/new-passes execution, full-model output/logprob and cancellation comparisons, boot/repeat performance preservation and restoration receipts. The existing hardware reservations take precedence. The runbook requires an exclusive window, reviewed coordinated plans, all-rank identity, guards and restoration. Production configuration and immutable baselines are unchanged. No hardware result, speedup, merge or promotion is claimed.
title: Qualify fixed-prompt decoder recovery after preemption
